sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the backpack, see Duffle bag.

Sports bag is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Duffle-style sports bags, labelled "RELTEK SPORT", are black and red 4x3 bags that spawn all barter items, provisions and medical items.
